observed_trades.setup: Bought IBIT as crypto turned up: a '4B setup' a couple of days ago, now back through the 200 SMA on two days of big volume. Plans to maybe peel a piece into the declining 200-day and keep the rest with a low cost basis.
observed_trades.quote: what starts off as a 4B setup just a couple of days ago, um with a little bit of luck, you know, you you get in at the right time. I bought some IBIT.
observed_trades.notes: 'A couple of days ago' dates the setup; he ties his buy to it without naming the day. Says his cost basis is 'in those 30s' (11:24) and repeats 'I own some IBIT' (11:01) and 'I have some IBIT' (12:08). Captions also mention 'a nice lowered anchored cost basis'.
